text:
Maya (People Ops): quick thread 1 — senior hire Anya (RU passport) accepted offer but her visa pathway is O-1. She asked if we can do premium processing, who drafts letters, and what onboarding/payroll looks like if petition files take longer. Proposed start: 2026-09-01. Tagging Marco for legal.

Carlos (Eng Manager): eager to have Anya. We can be flexible for a remote ramp if needed. Ideally onboard in September.

Anya Petrova: thanks all 1 excited. A few Qs: 1) does Redwood cover filing + premium fees? 2) what evidence do you need from me (publications, talks, patents)? 3) can I start contractor-remote before O-1 approval?

Marco (Immigration Counsel): summary (non-legal): O-1 requires strong evidence of extraordinary ability. Premium processing (15 calendar days) is available for O-1 and is common for faster adjudication; it adds extra fee. Employment start: company can file the O-1 petition before start; work authorization exists only after approval. Candidate cannot legally perform US work on basis of a pending O-1 petition. Contractor engagement while abroad is possible (with payroll/tax caveats). Company typically pays filing and premium fees for sponsored hires; confirm with People Ops/Finance. I'll prepare an evidence checklist and a draft recommendation letter template for internal reviewers.

Sana (Payroll): payroll note: Redwood runs US payroll. If Anya is abroad and wants pay before US payroll onboarding we'd need a contractor arrangement or EOR. Contractor pay requires a signed contractor agreement and 1099/contractor setup (subject to local rules). We'll confirm with Finance on one-off contractor payments.

Eric (Tax): tax flag: if Anya performs work while physically located in Russia or another country, local tax withholding/residency rules apply; if she does contractor work for Redwood from RU, we may create local tax obligations or require EOR. Keep contract period short if feasible and consult tax.

Dr. Lee (Research): for letters of support I can write a detailed recommendation emphasizing Anya's publications and invited talks. How many letters do you want? Last time we submitted 4 external expert letters plus internal support.

Marco (Immigration Counsel): recommended evidence list (short): - CV and bio - Copies of publications, citation counts - Conference programs showing invited talks - Patents or patent applications - Awards/recognitions - Media articles or press - Letters of recommendation (3-6, ideally external experts) - Employment offer + description of duties - High-salary evidence / negotiation notes Note: Marco can draft the internal support letter; external experts should be people familiar with Anya's research but independent.

Anya Petrova: I can provide CV, publication PDFs, list of talks, and 3 potential external letter writers (US and EU). I will not ask former managers at current employer for letters due to sensitivity.

Maya (People Ops): policy clarifications: - Filing fees: Redwood covers employment-based immigration filing & premium fees for roles above IC3 (approval pending Finance); I'll confirm. - Reimbursements: any candidate-paid courier/visa costs are reimbursable with receipts. - Start date: official US employment begins when Anya is on US payroll and has work authorization. We can set a tentative start and move to contractor/pay period arrangement in the interim if approved by Finance.

Carlos (Eng Manager): team can accept 4-6 weeks remote pre-onboarding as contractor if that's the fastest way. Ok to have Dr. Lee and two external letters.

Marco (Immigration Counsel): action items: - Marco to send O-1 evidence checklist and sample expert letter (owner: Marco) - Dr. Lee to draft internal recommendation (owner: Dr. Lee) - Anya to DM CV + pubs + list of potential external letter writers (owner: Anya) - Maya to confirm Finance approval for filing + premium and contractor interim pay (owner: Maya) - Sana to prepare contractor pay flows and banking requirements (owner: Sana)

visa-bot: Note: upload any vendor/legal invoices to `/expenses` with tag "Immigration-O1" for faster processing.

Anya Petrova: I'll DM docs tonight and send contact info for letter writers. Thanks everyone!

Maya (People Ops): thanks 1 I'll loop Finance this afternoon and circle back before COB. If anyone wants the sample letter template before Marco finalizes it, DM me. :sparkles:
